events.message: Target E-commerce shop (16 services) at http://192.168.49.2 (namespace flexascale-apps)
Application data reset (2 configured steps)

16 eligible services: api-gateway, cart-service, catalog-service, fraud-service, inventory-service, notification-service, order-service, payment-service, pricing-service, promotion-service, recommendation-service, review-service, search-service, shipping-service, user-service, wishlist-service
Resetting replicas to minimum (HPAs held at their minimum during the reset)
Holding HPAs at their minimum for 323 s more: the HPA downscale window since the previous load must expire for a comparable start

HPAs restored to their original bounds after the reset: api-gateway-hpa, cart-service-hpa, catalog-service-hpa, fraud-service-hpa, inventory-service-hpa, notification-service-hpa, order-service-hpa, payment-service-hpa, pricing-service-hpa, promotion-service-hpa, recommendation-service-hpa, review-service-hpa, search-service-hpa, shipping-service-hpa, user-service-hpa, wishlist-service-hpa

Comparable start: api-gateway=1, cart-service=1, catalog-service=1, fraud-service=1, inventory-service=1, notification-service=1, order-service=1, payment-service=1, pricing-service=1, promotion-service=1, recommendation-service=1, review-service=1, search-service=1, shipping-service=1, user-service=1, wishlist-service=1
Native HPA used on hand-back: CPU target 250%, scale-down window 60 s; restored after the run
FlexaScale operator holds the controller lease; HPAs are frozen per service before any scale
Auto mode: each service is assigned to FlexaScale or native HPA by the rules health -> confidence -> SLA risk -> efficiency, one owner at a time
Workload started: Calibration (steady mix), 45 users peak, spawn 5.0/s, 180s
